name: Netorare Ren'ai Jijou ~Joushi ni Karametorareta Otomegokoro~
original_name: 寝取られ恋愛事情 ～上司に絡め取られた乙女心～
source:
The story follows Sanada Akito and Seto Futaba, a couple working in the general affairs department of a small company. They handle various tasks and enjoy plenty of free time in their routine. Amidst a recession, the company celebrates a successful sales project with a congratulatory party.
Futaba, tasked with arranging the party venue with her boss Shimada Souichirou, goes on a restaurant tour where she ends up getting drunk due to Souichirou's encouragement. He takes advantage of Futaba's intoxicated state and they become involved in a physical relationship, leading her into an affair with him.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1257068]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
真田彰人與瀨戶雙葉是一對戀人，同在一家小公司的總務部工作。兩人平時幫忙處理各類雜務，日子過得頗為清閒。經濟不景氣，公司難得談成了一筆銷售專案，便要設宴慶祝。

雙葉奉命與上司島田總一郎一起挑選場地。兩人一家家餐廳去看場地，在總一郎的勸酒下，雙葉喝醉了。總一郎趁她醉酒之際與她發生了關係，雙葉自此被捲入與上司的地下戀情。
